concept.th-bit.def: The smallest piece of information - a single value that is either 0 (off) or 1 (on).
concept.th-binary.def: Counting with only 0s and 1s; every number is a pattern of on and off bits.
concept.th-byte.def: A group of eight bits, enough for 256 different values - the unit memory and file sizes are measured in.
